name: mandate-wallet
description: Connect a test wallet using the Mandate setup wizard or advanced manual configuration.
long_description: Local stdio tools for the Mandate ETH statistics tutorial. Select an existing fixed Agent profile and its private connection file. This extension does not create or fund an account, approve a mandate, or receive an owner private key. Service calls can spend test assets within the approved session; review the task and tool permissions before use. Supports configured local Anvil, Base Sepolia and Ethereum Sepolia profiles only.

tools.name: mandate_get_context
tools.description: Read the configured wallet, task, session and budget.

tools.name: mandate_request_authorization
tools.description: Prepare an authorization request for separate owner approval.

tools.name: mandate_search_services
tools.description: Discover services without expanding the owner-approved scope.

tools.name: mandate_quote_service
tools.description: Read a configured service's current x402 payment requirements.

tools.name: mandate_call_service
tools.description: Execute or recover an approved purchase; can spend test assets.

tools.name: mandate_get_receipt
tools.description: Read purchase receipts and evidence references.

tools.name: mandate_request_revoke
tools.description: Prepare a revocation request for separate owner approval.
